I recently visited Dobs Pets & Exotics to buy isopods and springtails for a terrarium, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The staff’s knowledge is absolutely excellent — extremely patient, helpful, and clearly passionate about what they do. It’s not a big flashy pet store with marketing gimmicks, but that’s the beauty of it. You get exactly what you’re looking for, and the prices are far more reasonable than the larger pet shops around Cork. Their selection of exotic pets is impressive too!

If you want genuine expertise, great value, and healthy animals, Dobs Pets & Exotics is definitely the place to go. Highly recommended!

We couldn't be happier with our experiences at Dobs. What a fantastic place with new exotic pets to see on every visit! We originally went to pick up some springtails for my son's vivarium but once there, he was inspired to start an aquarium too! We visited multiple times over a few months as he was setting it up and the staff were incredibly knowledgeable, encouraging and clearly devoted to all of the animals. Ruairí had lists of questions for them on each visit and the lads always remembered him, were so patient in answering his questions, made him feel welcome and gave great suggestions despite being so busy. I never usually give reviews but the knowledge and dedication of the staff at Dobs is so rare to see these days and I have no doubt that they have inspired a lifelong hobby for Ruairí. Thanks so much from Emer and Ruairí!
